reasoning_content:
The postinstall script needs REGIONALSTATISTIK_USER/SECRET credentials, which we don't have. The Dockerfile shows they are secrets. Those two scripts use credentials. The env file only has NEXT_PUBLIC_DIRECTUS_URL. So postinstall will fail on those scripts due to missing credentials, but the scripts continue (they call curl without checking). Actually postinstall.sh has no `set -e`, so it continues. But the mv will fail. Still exit 0 at the end.

For installation, the main goal is `yarn install` and then `yarn dev` works. The postinstall failing (partially) might not block yarn install. Let me check if assets/data already exists with the data files.
